title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-a4n2.3: hardcoded pop_buf[256] instead of TX_QUEUE_MAX_PACKET_SIZE
description:
Commit 1a774fce5 adds a tx_queue_pop call in both lichen_l2_send_inner() (lichen_l2.c:1576) and the bridge-zephyr copy (firmware/bridge-zephyr/subsys/lichen/lichen_l2.c:1078) that uses a stack buffer declared as 'uint8_t pop_buf[256]' instead of 'uint8_t pop_buf[TX_QUEUE_MAX_PACKET_SIZE]'.

Impact:
- If TX_QUEUE_MAX_PACKET_SIZE is ever changed to a value larger than 256, the pop_buf will be too small and tx_queue_pop will return -ENOMEM, silently discarding the queue entry without warning.
- Maintenance hazard: the hardcoded constant is silently coupled to the #define.
- TX_QUEUE_MAX_PACKET_SIZE is currently 256, so no runtime issue today.

Fix: Replace 'uint8_t pop_buf[256]' with 'uint8_t pop_buf[TX_QUEUE_MAX_PACKET_SIZE]' in both files.
